checked_decisions.finding: Entire slice confirmed as unit 2815020 (Master Gundam, pilot Master Asia) per work/ui/shout_groups.json; imperious/commanding register consistent throughout, matching character_names_021.json.

"スーパー・アジア" (Super Asia) is Master Asia's own self-mocking pun name (東西南北中央不敗 - undefeated in every direction); transliterated literally as no existing glossary entry covers it. Translator's proposal to add it to the glossary (see batch_14059_glossary_proposals.json) is reasonable and left for the orchestrator; not treated as a meaning error.

Long maxim-style lines (bluster/self-ignorance; strike-the-general strategy) heavily compressed under tight budgets but core boast/lesson preserved in both; verified against budget (both fit with margin).

"アリ地獄にはまったがごとく..." (lit. "as if fallen into an antlion's pit") rendered as "Like ants caught in a pit" - changes the specific image (an antlion trap catching prey) to a more generic ants-in-a-pit simile, but the accompanying clause ("the enemy comes just as we planned") still correctly conveys that the enemy walked into Master Asia's trap. Not a meaning reversal, left as stylistic paraphrase.

"それが貴様の実力か！" ("Is that your true strength?!") compressed to "That's all?!" under an 18-char budget that does not fit any phrasing retaining an explicit reference to strength/power; verified no shorter alternative preserves more of the source without exceeding budget. Accepted.
